records.rationale: All three original paths read, including new hook header and generic disabled stub. Retain final restricted fair-placement hook and GPL export with explicit SD low-nibble extraction/current wake flags and non-fork load synchronization. Nonnegative target bypasses native placement heuristic but now common select_task_rq checks CPU range BEFORE native affinity/online mask checks and native fallback. Preserve all LTS default fair selection, WF_CURRENT_CPU, energy placement and affinity logic. Fallback callback is also constrained to in-range is_cpu_allowed results so it cannot reintroduce invalid/outside-affinity choice. Invalid overrides resume native selection rather than accepting unsafe CPU IDs. This affects trusted module choices that violated native constraints; valid vendor selection stays supported.

All three paths read. Retain restricted idle-balancer selection with nr_cpu_ids default sentinel and negative suppression. Validate positive choices before per-CPU/mask access: range, not current CPU, membership in nohz idle and current native HK_TYPE_KERNEL_NOISE masks, and idle_cpu. Invalid positive overrides run native scan; negative means suppress (normalized -1). Native kick_ilb only checked negative before per-CPU access, so range guarding is necessary. Final native housekeeping type replaces historical HK_TYPE_MISC; CPU isolation and NO_HZ_IDLE are enabled in SDK. Callback cannot deliberately choose busy/non-housekeeping CPU; this is justified preservation of native placement/isolation conditions, not removal of the generic source interface. Mutable mask remains a trusted callback contract.

related_partial_commit.review: Complete original five-path patch read. Fallback hook guard is included in this source change, but original also contains RT lowest-rq override; current find_lowest_rq returns nonnegative callback CPU directly and its multiple proxy-aware callers need further review. Tick/enqueue/dequeue/can-migrate events have separate completed reviews.

security: Range guards precede mask/per-CPU use. Fallback overrides now obey native is_cpu_allowed, including normal affinity/active versus kernel/migration-disabled exceptions. Native cpuset/possible recovery remains untouched. Idle overrides preserve native housekeeping/isolation and idle selection constraints. Trusted callbacks can still modify pointed-to state; this does not validate arbitrary callback behavior or all RT placement paths.
uncertainty: Exact SDK vendor callbacks remain unconfirmed. Tests model valid eligibility bitmaps and stable masks, not actual concurrent CPU hotplug/RCU/locking. Generic interfaces retained, not omitted based on consumer search.
validation: 81000 task and 294912 idle model cases pass; old control makes 17820 modeled invalid mask accesses and violates selected contracts in 37746 task/108544 idle cases. Not every contract failure implies a memory fault (e.g. negative suppression normalization). Build 138 in progress.

subsequent_build_verification.result: Complete emulator workflow passed; kernel, 100 common modules, 45 virtual modules; all signatures and CRC/flag tables verified. No runtime verification.
